title: Invoke provider-neutral Companion explicitly and persist one classified current proposal

gates.name: companion_trigger_classifier_governance_regression
gates.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend/companion_governance tests/backend/agent_runtime tests/backend/agent_chat tests/backend/safety_gate tests/backend/task_follow_up -m "not real_model" -q

evidence_required: Exact Companion request/result/orchestration schema, target/effect matrix, and outbound snapshot results.

Current authorized PostgreSQL Plant/selected issue evidence plus exact persisted existing-issue summary_text, exact (recorded_at DESC,check_in_id DESC) check-in and one-row (measured_at DESC,measurement_id DESC) measurement selection, including new-issue summary absence, different latest pH/EC rows, equal-time ties, null preservation, and forbidden cross-row synthesis or other governance-field egress evidence.
Proof that only explicit run POST invokes Companion and every GET/feed/event/Task/startup/reconciliation non-trigger makes zero calls.
Proof that TASK-043 alone registers the complete Companion router in production main.py after TASK-040, while all read/decision/run routes and OpenAPI are reachable exactly once.

Pending MessageEnvelope, matching classification, TASK-041 current proposal/attention persistence, early duplicate with null runtime outcome and zero provider/envelope reconstruction, supersede, and no-governance-on-failure evidence.
Pre/post-I/O, issue-version, grant/revoke, archive, classifier, and proposal-write race evidence plus no fallback/fake/canned production output and safe audit/redaction.

Deterministic Companion plus Safety fake/spy exact-call evidence over PostgreSQL context, including timeout/provider-error/invalid-output, unbound production, one persisted matching classification/current proposal, and zero Safety decision/DecisionRecord/Task/action effect.

Current-attempt T3 protocol evidence with fresh functional verification, /verify VERDICT: PASS, per-task /red-verify SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, and the exact HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done marker before explicit-owner or scheduler closure.
purpose: Make canonical companion operational through one production-registered protected router and explicit provider-neutral command whose only successful product handoff is a strictly classified current proposal persisted by TASK-041 authority, after TASK-042 and TASK-040 have completed the governance, shared Task package, executor-composition, and Safety-classifier boundaries.
success_outcome: The complete Companion router is registered exactly once in the production app after TASK-040; one authorized explicit POST deterministically selects the canonical check-in and exactly one manual-measurement row, invokes exactly one explicit Companion spy and one explicit safety_gate spy, maps their strict matching results through pending MessageEnvelope and persisted classification, and persists exactly one current proposal with active attention through TASK-041. Deterministic evidence covers strict schemas, authorization plus post-I/O recheck, exact outbound allowlists, timeout/error/invalid output, redaction, unbound production, and no fallback/fake production without provider/model/base URL/credential/egress/network/live-smoke requirements; duplicate/non-trigger/failure paths create no extra effect.
anti_goals: Do not widen generic ProviderRequestV1, MessageEnvelope, SafetyClassificationResultV1, roster identity, TASK-041 proposal authority, or TASK-042 DecisionRecord semantics.
Do not add automatic domain-event, Task-completion, feed-refresh, startup, scheduler, worker, or reconciliation triggers.
Do not let the model decide, approve/reject, close, create a DecisionRecord or Task, authorize action, mutate Plant state, invoke tools/devices, or bypass classification/governance authority.
Do not add caller prompts/provider selection, UI/Bus/Timeline replay context, raw chat, memory, Team/tools/RAG, fallback, fake production output, or failure-silence substitution.
Do not omit the explicit test safety_gate fake/spy seam, merge pH/EC from different measurement rows, or treat generic independent pH/EC selection as Companion input.

Do not claim FT-013 acceptance from transport-only, schema-only, fake-production, fallback, or blocked/failed/model-silent output; require the complete deterministic authority and two-spy evidence matrix.

forbidden_scope: TASK-041 tables/focus/attention/proposal lifecycle or TASK-042 DecisionRecord/effect/close semantics except a narrowly proven compatibility repair.
Generic ProviderRequestV1, MessageEnvelope, SafetyClassificationResultV1, or canonical roster identity widening.
Frontend/PWA, automatic triggers, UI Feed/Bus/Timeline replay, raw chat, governance fields outside the exact registered Companion request allowlist, caller prompt, or arbitrary provider selection.
Decision/approval/close/Task/action/completion/Outcome/Plant-state/device authority, automated actuation, tools, RAG, memory, fallback, or fake production output.
ChatGPT/Codex credential stores, default provider/model selection, or cross-provider retry.
stop_conditions: TASK-041 proposal persistence cannot accept the validated runtime/classification handoff without widening its governance, effect, or authorization contract.
TASK-040 provider composition cannot construct a competence-specific Companion request without generic request widening or shared-file contract conflict.
The canonical project classifier cannot preserve exact proposed effect/task-kind matching for the governance handoff.
The deterministic Companion plus Safety fake/spy seams cannot prove exact calls and fail-closed production without fallback, fake production classification, or unredacted configuration.
Production composition would require fake/canned output, provider fallback, caller prompts, auth/UI/Bus/Timeline data egress, or direct decision/effect authority.
Existing uncommitted work makes shared provider/API/main/package edits unsafe to reconcile.

constraints: CompanionProviderRequestV1 contains only the canonical definition, explicit_user_command trigger, target mode, and one to four ordered authorized PostgreSQL records: Plant, selected issue with the exact persisted summary_text only for existing_issue, check-in by (recorded_at DESC,check_in_id DESC), and exactly one manual measurement by (measured_at DESC,measurement_id DESC), with no issue summary for new_issue, exactly matching refs, and no cross-row pH/EC synthesis.

CompanionModelResultV1 may speak only the closed governance proposal matrix or produce strict model-declared silence; action, physical/Safety approval, target, quantity, command, Plant-state, and unknown fields are schema-invalid.
Task effects map to a pending task_request envelope and require persisted safe_task_request with the exact same kind; discussion_only and none map to team_signal and require safe_information.
Only POST /api/plants/{plant_id}/companion/runs invokes the model; all reads, refreshes, events, Task completions, startup, and reconciliation paths are proven non-triggers.

TASK-043 alone edits backend/app/main.py for FT-013 and registers the already verified read/decision router plus run route only after both TASK-042 and TASK-040, making production composition sequential in the executable DAG.

Strict provider-neutral companion and safety_gate seams have no selected provider/model/base URL; production remains unbound and fail-closed, tests inject explicit fakes/spies, and no fallback exists. Sequential identical retry returns persisted refs with runtime_outcome=null before another call or MessageEnvelope construction; I/O is outside transactions and current guards repeat before TASK-041 persistence.

Deterministic acceptance requires exactly one Companion spy call, one Safety classifier spy call, and one classified current proposal; production fake, missing call, fallback, silence, blocked/mismatch, failure, or any direct Safety decision/DecisionRecord/Task/action effect is not acceptance.
invariants: Model output, MessageEnvelope, and classification are candidate/routing data; only TASK-041 authority persists current proposal/attention and only TASK-042 plus a human command creates later binding decisions.
The Companion model can never approve/reject/close, create DecisionRecord or Task, grant Safety/action authority, confirm Plant state, or produce a device effect.

The registered Companion allowlist includes exact persisted current open-Issue summary_text for existing_issue as untrusted non-authoritative governance context; Farm/auth/session/grant, UI Feed, Bus/Timeline replay, raw chat, attention/proposal/rationale/decision/history/caller content, prompts, provider history, hidden reasoning, credentials, local paths, and every unlisted field stay outside provider input.
Archived, unauthorized, revoked, or version-stale scope creates no proposal/effect, and restore never replays the denied run.

No Companion runtime receipt or MessageEnvelope replay row is persisted; a committed duplicate is reconstructed only as safe governance/classification refs and never as a fresh common runtime outcome.
Test fakes/spies are explicit seams only; no fake, canned, hardcoded, fallback, or failure-silence production path satisfies acceptance.
verification_targets: Strict request/result tests prove exact record union/order, canonical ref grammar, target/effect/task-text matrices, bounds, unknown-field rejection, source-ref subset, pending-envelope mapping, public/internal reason nullability, and runtime_outcome nullability for committed duplicates.

Outbound spies prove only authorized PostgreSQL Plant/issue, the deterministic latest check-in, and exactly one deterministic manual-measurement row cross egress; existing_issue carries exactly its persisted matching summary_text, new_issue carries none, different latest pH/EC rows are not merged, and every forbidden auth/UI/Bus/Timeline/chat/attention/proposal/rationale/decision/caller/prompt/provider field is absent.
Trigger tests prove only explicit POST invokes Companion and GET/detail/feed refresh/domain event/Task completion/startup/reconciliation each make zero calls.

Integration tests prove the direct SafetyGateClassificationService/storage contract, exact classification matching, one TASK-041 current proposal/attention on success, sequential identical duplicate with persisted refs and no provider/runtime/envelope replay, same-run concurrent single effect, distinct-run serialized supersede/refocus with the displaced open issue still readable as awaiting_human or decided, and no Safety decision/DecisionRecord/Task/action/Plant/device effect.

Production-app tests prove all Companion routes and OpenAPI entries are registered exactly once by this wave and that every affected backend/app/main.py owner is serialized through TASK-039 -> TASK-040 -> TASK-042 -> TASK-043 before the FT-013 registration.

Authorization/provider-neutral tests prove current pre/post-I/O grant/archive/version races, explicit Companion and Safety fake/spy construction, exact one-call counts, classifier not-configured/blocked/mismatch/no-proposal branches, timeout/provider-error/invalid-output handling, unbound-production failure, no default/fallback/fake production output, and redacted audit/evidence.
